items.title: How Big A Swing In eBay Stock Are You Actually Holding?
items.summary: eBay (EBAY) stock trades at about $113. It has returned 28.7% over the past year and sits about 5% below its 52-week high. The options market is pricing substantial movement ahead, with implied volatility pointing to a wide one-standard-deviation range between $79.44 and $160.45 over the next twelve months.

items.title: eBay (EBAY) Bans Airbag And Inflator Listings
items.summary: eBay (NasdaqGS:EBAY) has banned listings for airbags and airbag inflators after counterfeit and unsafe parts were exposed. The marketplace is removing existing airbag related listings and blocking new ones as part of tighter automotive safety controls. The move follows media scrutiny over potentially dangerous counterfeit airbags sold through third party sellers on the platform. eBay's decision to halt airbag and inflator sales is important, but only one piece of the wider risk picture. items.title: Is eBay Stock Worth The Ride?
items.summary: eBay (EBAY) has gained 5.4% over the past five trading days while the S&P 500 fell 1.3%. A stock rising in a falling market pulls money in. Five days say nothing about what a holding does to your money over the years you would own it. eBay's longer-term record presents a more mixed risk-adjusted picture.
